images.filename: Daunt Rock lightship rescue postage stamp.jpg
images.caption: Postage stamp (40×30mm) valued 5 pence issued by the Irish postal service on 28 March 1974 to commemorate the 150th anniversary of the of the Royal National Lifeboat Institution. The stamp depicts the lifeboat Mary Stanford rescuing seamen from the lightship Daunt during a hurricane in 1936.(Stamp designer: Michael Byrne, incorporating a painting by Bernard Gribble.)
images.alt: Postage stamp (40×30mm) valued 5 pence issued by the Irish postal service on 28 March 1974 to commemorate the 150th anniversary of the of the Royal National Lifeboat Institution. images.caption: Ballycotton harbour and lifeboat, a small fishery harbour to the east of the entrance to Cork Harbour. The lifeboat station opened in 1858. The present lifeboat house dates from 2002. The Trent class boat “Austin Lidbury” is kept at moorings in the harbour.
